mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idevelop_safeaccess_editnet ( ID, SUBNET_OLD, SUBNET_NEW, old_ip, new_ip, create_time ) VALUES (#{id}, #{subnetOld}, #{subnetNew}, #{oldIp}, #{newIp}, #{createTime});
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, ( SELECT o.full_name FROM sys_t_corp_shortname o WHERE o.org_no = t.company ) AS companyzw, ( SELECT b.dept_name NAME FROM idevelop_dept b WHERE b.id = t.dept_code ) AS departmentzw, ( SELECT n.type_name FROM dev_t_hardware_type n WHERE n.type_code = t.device_id ) AS device_idzw FROM idevelop_safeaccess_user_access t WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT t.id id, t.subnet_name subnetName, t.broadcast_address broadcastAddress, t.subnet_address subnetAddress, t.subnet_gateway subnetGateway, t.subnet_mask subnetMask, t.address_resolution_ip addressResolutionIp, t.dnsip dnsip, t.dnsip2 dnsip2, t.code code, w.sw_name switchboard, t.user_group userGroup, t.vlan_id vlanId, t.vlan_name vlanName, i.dept_name institutionCode, t.fill_date fillDate, t.fill_man fillMan, t.segment segment, t.ip1 ip1, t.location1 location1, t.ip2 ip2, t.location2 location2, t.default_time defaultTime, t.default_lease_time defaultLeaseTime, t.sp_id spId, t.sp_name spName, t.create_time crateDate, t.update_time updateDate, t.is_public bak1, t.bak_col2 bak2, t.bak_col3 bak3 FROM idevelop_safeaccess_subnet t left join idevelop_safeaccess_switche w on t.switchboard = w.id left join idevelop_dept i on i.id = t.institution_code where t.id = #{id}

SELECT n.operation_type, t.user_phone AS phone_no, n.device_source, n.id FROM idevelop_device_operation_detail t LEFT JOIN idevelop_device_operation n ON n.id = t.operation_id WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND n.is_deleted = 0 AND t.device_code = #{deviceNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY n.apply_date DESC

SELECT ua.*, unit.dept_name AS companyName, dept.dept_name AS deptName, ss.subnet_name AS subnetName, ss.network_type_name AS networkTypeName FROM idevelop_safeaccess_user_access ua LEFT JOIN idevelop_dept unit ON unit.id = ua.company and unit.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN idevelop_dept dept ON dept.id = ua.department and dept.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN idevelop_safeaccess_subnet ss ON ss.id = ua.subnet_id and ss.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ua.is_deleted = 0 and ua.company = #{param.company} and ua.mac_address like concat('%',#{param.macAddress},'%') and ua.ip_address like concat('%',#{param.ipAddress},'%') and ua.device_code like CONCAT('%',#{param.deviceCode},'%')
and ua.device_type = #{param.deviceType} and ua.approveu_user like concat('%',#{param.approveuUser},'%')
and ua.mi_charge_user like concat('%',#{param.miChargeUser},'%')
and ua.mi_user like concat('%',#{param.miUser},'%') and ua.is_access = #{param.isAccess} and ua.subnet_id = #{param.subnetId} and ua.region_code like CONCAT(#{param.regionCode},'%')
ORDER BY ua.create_time DESC

SELECT ua.*, unit.dept_name AS companyName, dept.dept_name AS deptName, ss.subnet_name AS subnetName FROM idevelop_safeaccess_user_access ua LEFT JOIN idevelop_dept unit ON unit.id = ua.company and unit.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN idevelop_dept dept ON dept.id = ua.dept_code and dept.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN idevelop_safeaccess_subnet ss ON ss.id = ua.subnet_id and ss.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ua.is_deleted = 0 and ua.ip_address = #{ipAddress} and ua.id = #{id} and ua.region_code = #{regionCode}
